exposure: Gestational age at birth (mildly preterm (31-32 weeks), moderately preterm (29-30 weeks), and extremely preterm (23-28 weeks))
outcome: Concentrations of 12 cytokines and growth factors in cord blood plasma
finding: Cord blood and cord tissue collections yielded high concentrations of hematopoietic stem cells and mesenchymal stem cells in BPD infants, accompanied by low circulating granulocyte-colony stimulating factor.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor influencing the collection parameters of hematopoietic and mesenchymal stem cells from umbilical cord blood and tissues.
